name: claude-mod-lab
description: Mods for learning the Claude Code mod API by running it: the mod-lab and its explorer bridge, a gallery of rendering techniques, small mods to start from, and a skill that scaffolds a new mod

plugins.name: mod-lab
plugins.description: Run calls on $ in a live session and see what each one dispatched and returned

plugins.name: mod-lab-bridge
plugins.description: Serves the mod-lab explorer page from this session and connects it: runs the probes it asks for and forwards runs and traces

plugins.name: mod-lab-target
plugins.description: A companion to mod-lab whose hooks fail on request, so /mod-lab verify can check what a failed hook leaves standing

plugins.name: mod-lab-keys
plugins.description: Keeps each change to the prompt box that came another way than an edit (a recalled prompt, a clear, a plugin's fill) for /mod-lab keys; it needs Claude Code 2.1.300

plugins.name: gallery-mod
plugins.description: Rendering techniques for mods, one tab each, drawn as well as the surface allows

plugins.name: raster-mod
plugins.description: A Raster in a pane, repainted by $.ui.blit with no render pass

plugins.name: image-mod
plugins.description: An Image in a pane whose pixels are made here and swapped by $.ui.blit

plugins.name: svg-mod
plugins.description: The session's tool calls as an Svg bar chart where the surface has Svg, and block glyphs on the terminal

plugins.name: links-mod
plugins.description: A Markdown in a pane whose links the mod answers itself

plugins.name: hover-mod
plugins.description: Three words in a pane; pointing at one shows a card over the rows above it, drawn hidden and revealed by a hover group, with no hook running

plugins.name: band-mod
plugins.description: A line above the prompt: the session's tool calls and the last one

plugins.name: sites-mod
plugins.description: A line under each finished tool call's row saying how long it ran

plugins.name: brackets-mod
plugins.description: Closes brackets as they are typed in the prompt box, steps over a closer, and paints the bracket beside the cursor with its partner

plugins.name: keycast-mod
plugins.description: The keys you press in the prompt box, drawn above it as you press them, for screen recordings and pairing

plugins.name: shortcodes-mod
plugins.description: Shortcodes of your own in the prompt box: type :tests: and the closing colon writes the prompt it stands for; a half-typed one shows the rest as ghost text

plugins.name: paint-mod
plugins.description: Paints slash commands in the prompt box as they are typed: a known one bold, an unknown one underlined, the rest of a partial one as ghost text

plugins.name: paste-guard-mod
plugins.description: Paints anything shaped like an API key in the prompt box red as it goes in, and holds back a prompt holding one until Enter is pressed again

plugins.name: draft-keeper-mod
plugins.description: Keeps the draft Ctrl+C clears from the prompt box and offers it back as a suggestion that Tab takes

plugins.name: mod-bootstrap
plugins.description: A skill that scaffolds a new mod: its manifest, hooks.json, a hooks module with one command, a type contract, a test and a README
